201:t_106:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll make the most of the situation we're in...! Earth and humanity have no time left!」

201:t_107:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「I was acting with the worst case in mind, but things are worse than I expected...」

201:t_107:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I can't let them meet their end here...! Even if it costs me my life!」

201:t_108:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(Wait for me... I'll save you, no matter what...!)

201:t_109:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$ has been frightened since before this operation...!」

201:t_109:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't give a damn what's causing it! I'll take on every last bastard who scares $$ティファ$$!」

201:t_110:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「All you've done is destroy the lives of people living in peace!」

201:t_110:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I won't accept you! I'll drive you off Earth!」

201:t_111:0.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll stop... this war... To do that...!」

201:t_111:1.en:
$$シン$$
「We'll strike at the heart of the Empire here! There are other enemies we have to fight!」

201:t_112:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「If we don't stop the Empire here, the fighting will spread even further...!」

201:t_112:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll do it...! I'm fighting with that resolve too!」

201:t_113:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(Why can't we understand each other...? Can't dialogue put an end to the fighting...?)

201:t_113:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(If that's true, then I... As the $$イノベイター$$ that $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ dreamed of...)

201:t_114:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(War takes people's lives... their possibilities...)

201:t_114:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... If fighting can protect someone's possibilities... their future, I'll do it...!)

201:t_115:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If you attack without even talking, you're no different from $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

201:t_115:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You'd better be ready! I'm... angry!」

201:t_116:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're a damn nuisance! Building something like this on Earth!」

201:t_116:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$! We're kicking these jerks who don't understand this planet's worth right out!」

201:t_117:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll do it! $$ノノ$$ will give it everything too! Because...!」

201:t_117:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Defeating evil is a hero's duty! That means it's $$ノノリリ$$'s job... and $$ノノ$$'s too!」

201:t_118:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It's all crap! Robbery, invasion, kidnapping, war!」

201:t_118:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If you've got time for that, listen to my song! Set your hearts on fire!」

201:t_119:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$... Wait for me.)

201:t_119:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'll fight... to bring back a world where you can sing freely!)

201:t_120:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Who is it...? This overwhelming presence... Whoever it is, they're no ordinary person...!)

201:t_121:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Out of my way! I'll shoot down every last one of you who stops me reaching the Imperial Palace!」

201:t_121:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're fired up today! Don't think it'll be easy to stop us!」

201:t_122:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「I heard this was the decisive battle, but I didn't expect to join in the middle of a huge crisis...!」

201:t_122:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「But we have to do it!」

201:t_122:2.en:
$$青山$$
「If the fighting won't end today, we have to make sure there's a tomorrow!」

201:t_122:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$いぶき$$, $$青山$$! We'll get everyone out, whatever it takes!」

201:t_122:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Even office workers will fight to bring back peace!」

201:t_123:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Malice and violence... Don't imagine you can rule people with such things...!」

201:t_123:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「People with hearts will keep resisting...! And we'll lead them into battle against you!」

201:t_123:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I have no intention of accepting anyone who won't listen as a negotiating partner!」

201:t_124:0.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... I'll fight so I can see you again...)

201:t_124:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'll come back alive...! That's my promise to you...!)

201:t_125:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll do it...! If we defeat the Emperor here, the fighting won't spread any further!」

201:t_125:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's why we came here! We'll do it, no matter what!」

201:t_126:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Seems this is no time to celebrate being called in as pinch hitters.」

201:t_126:1.en:
$$くらら$$
「This time, letting our guard down for even a moment could be really dangerous.」

201:t_126:2.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Tch...! Even I can't afford to enjoy the thrill this time!」

201:t_126:3.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「But we must escape this desperate situation...!」

201:t_126:4.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「To carry our hope into tomorrow...!」

201:t_126:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Let's go, everyone! We've got to do our share and cover for my seniors who aren't here!」

201:t_126:6.en:
$$葵$$
「We're serious this time! Let's do this!!」

201:t_127:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll punch through! Whatever stands in our way!」

201:t_127:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then it's straight to the Imperial Palace! I'll settle this with my drill!」

201:t_128:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(What is this uneasy feeling...? Have I... made a terrible mistake...?)

201:t_128:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(No... If the enemy has set a trap, a frontal assault is the proper way to handle whatever happens! We have to keep going!)

201:t_129:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, keep reporting the balance of forces.」

201:t_129:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Depending on the situation, I may recommend withdrawal.」

201:t_129:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't think about retreat now! We'll concentrate on moving forward!」

201:t_130:0.en:
$n
(I have to do this...! For everyone who helped me... Above all, for myself...!)

201:t_130:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
(His heart wavers between hope and despair... Is there... nothing more I can do...?)

201:t_131:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Sorrow is spreading... From that Imperial Palace, into the world...)

201:t_131:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I'll end this here, whatever it takes...! No matter what we're up against!)

201:t_132:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Of course! ...That's what I'd like to say, but this time we might be in trouble...」

201:t_132:3.en:
$$ランド$$
(This prickling feeling... Looks like we've stepped into something more dangerous than we ever imagined.)
